title: Enhance Your AL Development with the AL MCP Server
summary: The AL MCP server is a Model Context Protocol server that exposes tools allowing AI agents to download symbols, build, compile, and publish AL projects directly. It enables agents like GitHub Copilot to verify their own code changes automatically, removing the need for manual compilation steps between AI suggestions and deployment.
key_points: AL MCP server ships with AL development tools and provides a standardized interface for AI agents to perform core AL development tasks
Setup requires the AL Language extension, .NET 8 runtime, and optionally adding altool to PATH; configuration can be stored in .vscode/mcp.json and shared with teams
The server exposes tools including al_build, al_compile, al_publish, al_downloadsymbols, al_symbolsearch, and authentication tools for cloud environments
AI agents can now independently compile code, read errors, and iterate fixes without human intervention, enabling fully automated development workflows
This foundation enables future automated workflows where agents can handle symbol download, code generation, building, and publishing without manual steps

quotes.text: Once an agent can call these tools, it can verify its own work. It can compile, read the errors, fix them and try again.
quotes.why_it_matters: This describes the core value: AI agents become autonomous developers that can self-correct instead of requiring human review between suggestions and compilation.

quotes.text: You stop being the middleman between Copilot and the compiler.
quotes.why_it_matters: Summarizes the transformational benefit: developers are freed from manual compilation cycles and can focus on higher-level design decisions.
